The '''Allanteen VI shipyards''' were [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] located at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Allanteen VI/Legends|Allanteen Six]].<ref name="WS" /> They were among the oldest shipyards of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and originated the restoration of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] circa [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]].<ref name="TEGtW" /> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], they manufactured<ref name="WS" /> [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]]'<ref name="TEGtW" /> [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] for the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. Three of them, including the [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']], were used during the Republic's [[Battle of Bothawui/Legends|defense]] of [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]].<ref name="WS" /> The Allanteen Six shipyards were turned into [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] military shipyards after the [[Declaration of a New Order]] and dedicated to the production of [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]].<ref name="TEGtW" />
